subgoal.rationale: Current measured range is 100.0 m with a closing velocity of -0.06 m/s along the X axis. We target an intermediate approach waypoint at 50.0 m (half the current separation) directly along the port centerline [50.0, 0.0, 0.0] m. The closing velocity is commanded at -0.08 m/s, which satisfies both primary and secondary speed envelopes (max horizontal speed 0.10 m/s) while preserving ample braking margin given our 0.005 m/s^2 acceleration limit.
alternatives: Adopt the raw RL lookahead position at 98.96 m, rejected because targeting a point only ~1 m ahead causes the controller to brake prematurely and stall the long-range approach.
Adopt the RL suggested closing speed of 0.46 m/s, rejected because it violates the secondary motion envelope limit of 0.10 m/s.
Hold current position and remain stationary at 100 m, rejected because nominal closing phase requires reducing port separation toward the dock.
subgoal.rl_assessment: The RL heuristic proposes a short 4-second lookahead position at [98.96, -0.10, -0.03] m with a closing speed of ~0.46 m/s. We reject the short lookahead waypoint because targeting a position just 1.04 m ahead causes early braking and stalls approach progress. We also limit the RL suggested speed (-0.46 m/s) down to -0.08 m/s to strictly comply with the secondary envelope limit of 0.10 m/s. Minor cross-track offsets suggested by the RL policy are zeroed out to maintain a clean centerline trajectory.

result.minimum_speed_rule: Transit preference; braking and capture may use zero speed.
